_help.depth: audit = report only | lite = 1 brand + 1 home page concept | full = 3 brands x 3 key pages x 3 layouts
_help.minScoreToSkip: skip prospects whose overall audit score is at or above this
_help.sender: shown in the report and email; empty fields are left out
_help.cloudflareProject: Cloudflare Pages project the whole prospects/_site folder deploys to
_help.publicBaseUrl: optional custom domain for report links, e.g. https://reviews.knowtific.com.au (default https://<cloudflareProject>.pages.dev)
